full_judgment:
Md. Ruhul Amin J: This petition for leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment of March 28, 2004 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 4691 of 1999 making absolute the Rule obtained against the judgment and decree dated August 12, 1999 of the Court of Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge) and Artha Rin Adalat, Rajshahi in Title Appeal No. 116 of 1998 dismissing the same. The appeal was filed against the judgment and decree dated April 27, 1998 of the Court of Assistant Judge, Mohanpur, Rajshahi in Other Class Suit No. 17 of 1995 decreeing the same. The suit was filed seeking declaration that removal of the plaintiff from the post of Head Master is illegal and that appointment of defendant No.3 as Head Master of Hazrapara Non-Government Primary School is illegal and that the plaintiff is still the Head Master of Hazrapara Non-Government Primary School. 

 5. The trial Court on consideration of evidence, both oral and documentary arrived at the finding that the plaintiff has been able to prove his case and thereupon decreed the suit.
